french-first-conversation-q1.explanation: Je m’appelle introduces the name you use in the conversation.

french-first-conversation-q2.explanation: This asks the partner to repeat rather than pretending you understood.

french-first-conversation-q3.explanation: Vous can politely address one person; it also has a plural use.

french-first-conversation-q4.explanation: The exercise works with fictional details and does not require private information.
